desc: Derive the equivalence: valid numbers are exactly \(x^2\) where \(x\) has exactly two distinct prime factors.
Implement a sieve up to \(10^6\) that counts distinct prime divisors for every integer.
Precompute and sort squares \(x^2\) for all roots having exactly two distinct prime factors.
Answer each query with an upper-bound binary search over the precomputed squares.
Implement efficient stdin/stdout handling and verify boundary behavior up to \(10^{12}\).
